title: Flexell Space Establishes French Subsidiary to Strengthen European Presence
text:
– Paris-based FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS creates a local business hub in Europe
– New entity to support ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers, from technical reviews to supply planning

Paris, France – Flexell Space, a space solar solution company, announced the establishment of its French entity, FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS, in Paris to strengthen support for ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers.
The move comes as the company’s business discussions in Europe advance. Flexell Space is currently in talks with multiple European customers regarding collaboration agreements and volume supply of space solar cells and power solutions. Through its local presence, the company aims to accelerate customer communication and strengthen its ability to support business activities ranging from technical reviews to negotiations on supply terms.
- Advancing Contract and Production Discussions with European Customers
Space solar cells require close coordination on performance, dimensions, reliability, and delivery schedules, depending on each customer’s spacecraft design and operating environment. Beyond initial product introductions, discussions involve technical documentation reviews, sample evaluations, environmental test results, and design adjustments. Progressing toward volume supply also requires alignment on production schedules and quality management processes.
Flexell Space said that as discussions with European customers move toward contracts and volume production, a local presence has become increasingly important for responding promptly to customer needs. The French entity will support these activities and serve as a link between European customers and the company’s R&D and manufacturing teams in Korea.
The company plans to deepen engagement with customers and partners across Europe, including France, Germany, Italy, and Lithuania. By gaining a closer understanding of each customer’s development schedule and technical requirements, it aims to facilitate timely decisions and follow-up actions throughout the collaboration process.
- Connecting Next-Generation Space Solar Technology with Production Readiness
Flexell Space develops next-generation tandem solar cells and related power solutions for space applications. Its tandem architecture combines solar cells with different characteristics to deliver the performance, low weight, and cost competitiveness required for space missions.
The company is expanding beyond solar cell development into modules and arrays tailored to customer missions and satellite platforms. Its preparations for commercialization and volume production address not only product performance, but also reliability in the space environment, manufacturing process repeatability, quality management, and supply stability.
With the establishment of its French entity, Flexell Space plans to incorporate feedback from European technical discussions into product development and supply planning more quickly. It will strengthen coordination between its Korean R&D teams and European customers by communicating required specifications and evaluation criteria, while sharing development progress and validation results.
The company will also continue discussions on supply scope, development schedules, production volumes, and delivery timelines to translate ongoing negotiations into concrete business outcomes.
- Building Long-Term Partnerships Across Europe
Flexell Space plans to operate its French entity as a hub for developing long-term relationships with European customers. Alongside supporting existing customer projects, it will explore new product applications and joint development opportunities with local space companies and research institutions.
As satellite missions and platforms become more diverse, space power solutions increasingly require development and supply arrangements tailored to specific operating conditions. Flexell Space’s strategy is to maintain close contact with customers and connect their requirements with R&D and manufacturing preparations to expand its European business.
“We are currently discussing contracts and volume supply with multiple European customers. As these discussions progress, being closer to our customers has become increasingly important in turning them into tangible results,” said Keo-san Lee, CFO of Flexell Space. “Our French entity will help accelerate technical discussions and business execution, while enabling us to respond more closely to our customers’ development and production schedules.”
“In the space industry, technical capability must be accompanied by confidence in a supplier’s ability to deliver products reliably,” Lee added. “By connecting our R&D and manufacturing capabilities in Korea with local customer support in Europe, we aim to build stronger, longer-term partnerships.”
